56-Passenger Motorcoach

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The 56-Passenger Motorcoach is the biggest, most luxurious vehicle in the fleet: a full-size coach with fifty-six opulent leather seats, each one reclining on its own, and underfloor luggage bays that take a hundred and twenty-five bags.

Request a quoteCall to reserve

About the 56-Passenger Motorcoach

State-of-the-art ambient lighting, a sound system, overhead compartments, a built-in cooler for refreshments, and curtains over tinted windows for privacy. No on-board restroom and no WiFi; a screen on select coaches.

The coach for the big wedding, the big event, the team on the road, the school or college group, and any time a large crowd needs to move as one.

Seats: Opulent leather seats, each reclining on its own

56-Passenger Motorcoach rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $325 with a 5-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $1,250. Seats 56, room for 125 bags.
